title: A Pedagogical Introduction to Anomalies in Quantum Field Theory
summary: These notes are aimed at providing a relatively concise and self-contained introduction to anomalies in quantum field theory. A first part reviews the necessary notions of quantum field theory, in particular its functional integral formulation which we use throughout.
